terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of PSX Trade Desk (the "Service"), a research publication covering the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
sections: 1. What the Service is — and is not

PSX Trade Desk is a research publication. It publishes general commentary on the Pakistan Stock Exchange — market and sector trends, macro conditions, backtested strategy methodology, and the scored track record of third-party research houses — for an educational audience. This is the general market and sector commentary contemplated by Regulation 2(h) of the SECP Research Analyst Regulations 2015 (as amended), which the Service is designed to stay within. On that basis the operator is not registered as, and does not act as, a research analyst, investment adviser, broker, dealer, portfolio manager, or fund under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) regime or any other. The Service does not publish buy, sell, or hold calls, price targets, or stop-losses on any named security. Nothing on the Service is personalized investment advice, a recommendation, a solicitation, or an offer to buy or sell any security.
2. No advice, no fiduciary duty

We do not provide personalized financial, investment, legal, or tax advice, and we owe you no fiduciary duty. The Service does not know your financial situation, objectives, or risk tolerance, and nothing it outputs is tailored to you. Any decision you make is your own, taken at your own risk. You should consult a licensed professional before making any investment decision.
3. No execution

The Service never places orders and never has custody of your money or securities. All execution is manual, by you, through your own broker. We cannot and do not execute, guarantee, or influence any trade.
4. No performance promise

Past performance, backtests, and scored track records do not predict or guarantee future results. Backtests are hypothetical and have inherent limitations. Losses are expected and are documented. We make no promise of profit or return of capital.
5. Data sources and accuracy

Market data is sourced from third parties (including the PSX DPS portal, Yahoo Finance, and public business press) and may be delayed, incomplete, or wrong. We do not warrant the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of any data or analysis, and we are not liable for errors in third-party data.
6. Your account

You must provide accurate registration information, keep your credentials secure, and are responsible for activity under your account. You must be of legal age to enter a contract in your jurisdiction. One person per account. We may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these Terms.
7. Subscriptions and payment

Paid access is offered on a subscription or trial basis. Fees, billing period, and trial length are shown at sign-up. Unless stated otherwise, subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; you may cancel at any time and access continues to the end of the paid period. Fees are stated exclusive of any applicable taxes. We may change pricing on prospective notice.
8. Acceptable use

You may not scrape, resell, redistribute, or republish the Service's content; reverse-engineer it; use it to build a competing product; or use it for any unlawful purpose, including market manipulation or trading on the basis of material non-public information.
9. Intellectual property
The Service, its analysis, code, and design are owned by the operator. You get a personal, non-transferable, revocable licence to use the Service for your own research. No other rights are granted.
10. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any trading or investment losses, or for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, arising from your use of the Service. Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the fees you paid in the three months before the claim.
11. Indemnity
You agree to indemnify the operator against claims arising from your use of the Service or your breach of these Terms.
12. Changes and termination

We may modify the Service or these Terms; material changes will be notified in-app or by email and take effect prospectively. We may discontinue the Service or your access. You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time.
13. Governing law
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, and disputes are subject to the courts of Pakistan.
14. No affiliation with PSX or SECP

PSX Trade Desk is an independent research publication. It is not affiliated with, connected to, endorsed by, sponsored by, or licensed by the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX), the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP), or any other exchange or regulator. "PSX" is used only to identify the market the Service covers. Any market data referenced from the PSX Data Portal is used under, and remains subject to, PSX's own terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data PSX Trade Desk collects, why, and your choices. We collect the minimum needed to run your account and keep your data private to you.
sections: What we collect

Account data: your email address and password (the password is hashed by our authentication provider — we never see or store it in plain text). Profile data you choose to give: onboarding quiz answers, your watchlist, private per-ticker notes, and preferences. Technical data: basic, standard request logs needed to operate and secure the Service.
What we do NOT collect

We do not collect your bank, card, brokerage, CNIC, or national ID details. The Service never asks you to enter financial credentials. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with advertisers or data brokers.
How your data is used

To authenticate you, save your watchlist/notes/preferences, personalize which shared research surfaces first, operate the Service, and communicate essential account or (if you opt in) digest emails. Your watchlist and notes are private to your account and enforced at the database level (row-level security) so other users cannot read them.
Astrology birth data

If you use the optional astrology features, you may provide your birth date, time, and place. This is sensitive personal data. It is used solely to compute the birth chart and astro readings you request, is stored privately to your account under the same row-level security as your notes, is never sold or shared, and is deleted when you remove it or close your account. The astrology layer is provided for educational and general-interest purposes and is never investment advice.
Chrome companion

If you install Henneth Desk Companion, it reads the URL, page title, headings, and limited visible text on supported TradingView, PSX DPS, and business-news pages locally on your device to identify a PSX ticker. It sends the detected ticker, authenticated research questions, and account note operations to Henneth's desk API. Ticker detection does not send the full page text to us. The extension does not access brokerage accounts, place orders, or sell browsing data. Its session token stays in browser extension storage and is used only to authenticate desk requests.
Where it is stored

Account and profile data are stored with Supabase (our authentication and database provider). The site and desk API are hosted on Vercel. Ask the Desk questions and limited conversation context are sent through the desk API to Groq to generate a response. These providers process data on our behalf under their own security terms.
Cookies
We use only the cookies/local storage required to keep you signed in and remember essential preferences. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
Your rights

You can view and edit your profile data in the app, export or request a copy, and delete your account and its data at any time by contacting us. Deleting your account removes your profile, watchlist, and notes.
Data retention
We keep your data while your account is active and delete it on account closure, except where we must retain limited records to meet legal obligations.
Contact
Privacy questions or deletion requests: mwasayi@gmail.com.

risk.title: Risk Disclosure
risk.intro: Read this before relying on anything the Service shows. Investing in equities carries real risk, including the loss of your entire capital.
sections: This is research, not advice

Everything on PSX Trade Desk is educational information about publicly available market data. It is never personalized advice, a recommendation, or a solicitation to buy or sell. The desk does not know you and cannot tell you what is suitable for you.
You can lose money

Prices go down as well as up. You may lose some or all of your capital. Only invest money you can afford to lose. Leverage, concentration, and illiquidity can amplify losses — this desk is long-only and daily-timeframe by design, but your own risk is your responsibility.
Past performance is not future results

Scored track records, backtests, and historical statistics are hypothetical or historical and do not predict future performance. A strategy that worked before can fail. Backtests cannot fully capture costs, slippage, liquidity, or regime change.
Data may be wrong or delayed

Prices and fundamentals come from third parties and may be delayed (TradingView data is ~15 minutes delayed), incomplete, or erroneous. Verify any number against your broker and primary sources before acting on it.
PSX-specific risks

The Pakistan Stock Exchange can be volatile and less liquid than developed markets, with circuit breakers, currency (PKR) risk, macro and political risk, and thin trading in some names that can make entering or exiting a position difficult.
Do your own research

Use this Service as one input among many. Confirm the thesis, read the company's own filings, consider your own situation, and consult a licensed professional before making any investment decision. The decision, and its outcome, are yours.
